title: PostgresOnly
description: Query JSONB and arrays, then let Ptah plan and apply a PostgreSQL GIN index.
note: Requires PostgreSQL: UUID, JSONB, arrays, timestamptz, and GIN indexes. Selecting this scenario loads PostgreSQL automatically.

files.schema.sql:
-- PostgreSQL-only types: UUID, JSONB, arrays, and timestamptz.
CREATE TABLE events (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL,
  tags TEXT[] NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
files.README.md:
# PostgresOnly

A real, memory-only PostgreSQL database powered by PGlite.
The table contains two synthetic events. Query JSONB, then add a GIN index
to schema.sql and apply it through Ptah. Reloading discards this database.

    ptah db capabilities --db-url postgres://pglite/app
